name: Zephyr Yield Share
oneLiner: ZYS is Zephyr Protocol's yield-share wrapper over ZSD, with its NAV moving as protocol yield accrues into the underlying ZSD yield reserve.
collateral: ZSD held in the Zephyr Protocol yield reserve; each ZYS share represents a claim on the protocol's ZSD yield reserve balance
pegMechanism: ZYS is a NAV-style yield-share token rather than a flat one-dollar stablecoin. Its share price moves against ZSD as protocol yield accrues into the ZSD yield reserve.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Zephyr's v2.0.0 release introduced the yield reserve and ZYS at hardfork block 360000. Zephyr's public scanner timestamps that activation block at 2024-10-13T11:39:13Z, establishing the wrapper implementation date.

sources.label: Zephyr Protocol v2.0.0 ZSD Yield release

oracleRisk.summary: ZYS is a share of Zephyr's ZSD yield reserve rather than a borrower debt market; it inherits the underlying ZSD reserve-pricing risk, whose production oracle provider and failure handling remain unpublished.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: Zephyr documents ZYS as a share of the ZSD yield reserve that provides variable yield from ZSD holdings. ZYS holders do not open borrower positions or control collateral liquidation, so there are no ZYS-specific collateral or liquidation branches to inventory; the underlying ZSD parent carries the protocol-wide reserve and oracle risk.

oracleRisk.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08 against official Zephyr v2.3.0 source commit 67c5f53b878fef41fb5e74c4382d5b7a2f37fd8a and native-chain HF11 block 837231 (2026-08-08 19:36:16 UTC; hash 9e024c96ef5e31b25daa407c0715a43e74f9fdfc18c258bf4c50077ef15f160d). ZYS is the native Zephyr yield asset, not a production EVM token. Same-asset ZYS sends map to YIELD_TRANSFER, and the reviewed source exposes no separate address-level blacklist, holder freeze, seize, privileged burn, or current issuer transfer-control path. ZYS shares the historical 2025 network-wide audit/hardfork transaction restriction with ZSD; this was a consensus-wide migration rather than a current holder-targeted issuer control. No direct blacklistability established.

mintAuthority.summary: ZYS is minted and redeemed through Zephyr's native consensus conversion between ZSD and ZYS at the protocol yield-share price. The pinned v2.3.0 source exposes user-facing MINT_YIELD and REDEEM_YIELD transaction types with RingCT amount-conservation checks and no admin or emergency mint route.

controls.label: Zephyr native ZSD-to-ZYS conversion rules
controls.capDescription: ZYS issuance burns user-supplied ZSD and mints ZYS at the consensus yield-share rate; the reviewed binary exposes no privileged supply-creation path.
controls.evidence: At the still-current Zephyr v2.3.0 commit 67c5f53b878fef41fb5e74c4382d5b7a2f37fd8a, source/destination asset identity deterministically selects MINT_YIELD only for ZSD-to-ZYS conversion and REDEEM_YIELD only for ZYS-to-ZSD conversion. RingCT verification derives the expected minted amount from the consensus yield price and 0.1% conversion fee, then enforces balance conservation. The transaction enum contains no admin, foundation, or emergency mint type; Explorer block 837231 confirms the live network remains on HF11.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08. GitHub still identifies v2.3.0 at commit 67c5f53b878fef41fb5e74c4382d5b7a2f37fd8a as the latest official release, and Explorer block 837231 confirms the live network remains on HF11. ZYS is a native consensus asset, so an EVM-style owner or proxy slot is not the relevant authority interface. The pinned transaction router permits ZYS creation only when a user converts ZSD through MINT_YIELD; the RingCT verifier calculates the minted quantity from the consensus yield price, applies the protocol fee, and rejects an imbalanced proof. ZYS issuance is a native consensus conversion, not an issuer-backend reserve reconciliation path, so reconciliation is explicitly not-applicable. No privileged mint transaction type or key-controlled bypass exists in the reviewed current source.

reserves.name: ZSD yield reserve backing ZYS shares
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Zephyr Protocol on-chain ZSD yield reserve

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-30: Zephyr documentation still lists ZYS as the native ZSD Yield Coin and the yield page defines it as a share of the ZSD yield reserve, minted and redeemed against ZSD through the consensus MINT_YIELD/REDEEM_YIELD conversion in the pinned v2.3.0 source (still the latest official release). The live Zephyr Scanner reserve snapshot (captured 2026-07-19 at height 822991; the endpoint trailed the network tip 830837 by roughly 11 days at read time) reports zsd_yield_reserve 355,777.18 ZSD against zys_circ 183,232.76 ZYS at a yield price of 1.9417 ZSD per ZYS, corroborating that ZYS is backed exclusively by the protocol ZSD yield reserve. Composition remains 100% tracked zsd-zephyr-protocol dependency (wrapper), ku=0 at the ZYS level; the scanner is the protocol's own self-reported telemetry, which is noted as the assurance ceiling.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Zephyr Protocol documentation, yield description, pinned v2.3.0 source, and the live Zephyr Scanner reserve snapshot
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No additional direct ZYS reserve slice is identified; underlying ZSD backing remains the upstream asset's reserve question.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: ZYS is a share claim on Zephyr's on-chain ZSD yield reserve rather than assets held by a legal custodian; the reviewed sources do not establish account segregation, insolvency treatment, or reuse terms, and the underlying ZSD backing composition is the upstream asset's reserve question.

notices.title: Native private-chain yield share
notices.message: ZYS is tracked as Zephyr's yield-share wrapper over ZSD, not as base ZSD itself. Pharos sources supply, price, and APY from Zephyr Scanner because CoinGecko and DefiLlama do not expose this wrapper.
